note: These three generated the P3 taxonomy. They are calibration items and are NEVER scored. Any scoring run that includes them is invalid.

content_note: The seed names these three but does not encode their boards. They are listed so that a scoring harness can exclude them by id; encoding their boards is not required and would not make them scoreable.
